<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>New Zealand-India FTA:</strong> The New Zealand Parliament has passed legislation to implement a landmark free trade agreement with India, which is set to reduce tariffs on 95% of Indian exports starting this October.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Nagaon Lok Sabha Bypoll:</strong> Candidates, including the BJP&#x27;s Devasish Sharma, have filed nominations for the upcoming Nagaon by-election in Assam, marking a significant political contest in the region.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I72</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>UCC Debate:</strong> National Conference leader Omar Abdullah has challenged the BJP to introduce a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill directly in Parliament rather than pursuing it through individual state legislatures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPRXVNU0V3eWh0YjdBaWVNOTRvRGhQQ2RiMFpKdWNpZXBYQXM1WjRmcWxyS252ZDh0a2NMR0JMTDRxV21kbTNkTTRwMW1qeUJ6Tm9EczVNMUFoNDNIWUM0U1doQ1BadDdUY0lxNXVOUFlSU29wZlpKa2VGNmtBa05WSmd6ekEyeEpBWGcyVWxucFBxdHVoTGVFWm5YMHdwclBJ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I63</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I64</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>EPFO Wage Ceiling:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved an increase in the Employees&#x27; Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month to expand mandatory social security coverage.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Supreme Court Oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea regarding a standard format for election manifestos and has issued a stern directive to states to improve the implementation of menstrual hygiene programs in schools.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
